scene: The brass mechanism rattles, spitting out patterned sheets and whirring gears.
picture: Flat side-scrolling view along a metal floor. Far left sits the rumbling brass folding machine's intake hopper with a red valve wheel. The Pacific Islander girl stands left of centre, reaching toward the moving rubber conveyor belt holding a gleaming gold folded paper at centre. Right stands the machine frame with an attached ladder.
shown: a large red valve wheel attached to the brass hopper on the left
a shimmering gold folded sheet poised on the rubber belt at centre
a slender metal ladder mounted against the machine frame on the right
